title: Devonshire West | KEY.co
description_expanded: The thoughtfully designed kitchen features custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, and premium appliances, offering both beauty and functionality for entertaining. Multiple wet bars and spacious living areas make hosting effortless, while covered gulf-front porches provide the perfect setting for sunset views and ocean breezes. Outside, a private pool and an IPE beach walkover lead directly to the sugar-white sand, inviting days spent by the water. With elegant bedroom suites, a serene primary retreat with a sitting area and coffee bar, and added conveniences including a six-seater golf cart and six adult bikes, this remarkable beachfront home offers a peaceful and refined coastal escape just minutes from Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Set within the exclusive gated enclave of Pelican Circle in Seacrest, this exceptional gulf-front retreat offers 90 feet of pristine beachfront and private beach access along the emerald waters of 30A. A tranquil garden courtyard with a tiled fountain creates a memorable arrival, leading into interiors defined by refined craftsmanship and coastal elegance. Venetian plaster walls, coffered wood ceilings, and graceful archways frame expansive living spaces filled with natural light. Floor-to-ceiling folding glass doors seamlessly connect the beachfront living area to the outdoors, revealing sweeping Gulf views and creating a stunning indoor-outdoor experience designed for gathering and relaxation.

Features: Outdoor seating Pool alarm Private beach access
Guests assume all risk for use of pools
